device: Android emulator (Pixel-class, 1080x2400, Android 17), PKU Harness release build
note: Real app captures with only public campus data visible (free classrooms, plugin documents). The status bar clock is the real time of capture; no notifications are shown. Files with .zh are the same screens with the app language set to Simplified Chinese.

caption.zh: 问一句“明天上午二教哪里有空教室”，AI 调用空闲教室插件，直接给出一张可点的卡片
caption.en: Ask for a free classroom tomorrow morning; the assistant calls the classrooms plugin and answers with a card

caption.zh: 一次完整的对话：调用插件、流式生成回答与卡片（2 倍速）
caption.en: A full chat turn: plugin call, streamed answer and card (2x speed)

caption.zh: 所有校园服务都是插件，一页网格管理开关与状态
caption.en: Every campus service is a plugin, managed from one grid

caption.zh: 插件详情：它能做什么、能访问哪些网站、看板组件和来源链接一目了然
caption.en: Plugin details: what it may do, which sites it reaches, its widgets and its source link

caption.zh: 按“读取 / 修改 / 花钱”分别决定：AI 直接做、先问你，还是不许做
caption.en: Per effect (read, change, money), choose whether the AI just does it, asks first, or never does

caption.zh: 粘贴一个链接安装插件，安装前先看清它能访问什么、能做什么
caption.en: Install a plugin from a link and review what it can reach and do first
